## recorded

21 entries.

| ID | Title |
|---|---|
| [FND-VIEW-001](../../findings/FND-VIEW-001.md) | Every combat scene archive holds its blocks as 96-byte records ending in 0xCC 0xCC with a 16-byte label at offset 78 |
| [FND-VIEW-002](../../findings/FND-VIEW-002.md) | Every combat scene map is 128 by 128 block numbers stored column by column |
| [FND-VIEW-003](../../findings/FND-VIEW-003.md) | The heading helper folds the vector into octants around floor(0x20 * minor / major), and callers pass (-dy, dx) |
| [FND-VIEW-004](../../findings/FND-VIEW-004.md) | Sine, cosine and rotation use a 64-entry signed 1.15 quarter-wave table and round each product with (p + 0x3FFF) >> 15 |
| [FND-VIEW-005](../../findings/FND-VIEW-005.md) | The first-person view starts with elevation 0x80, horizon at half the view height, and the view width as ray width |
| [FND-VIEW-006](../../findings/FND-VIEW-006.md) | The raycaster forms its ray from a fixed forward basis and a lateral basis from the view column, and returns the first opaque candidate |
| [FND-VIEW-007](../../findings/FND-VIEW-007.md) | The traversal walks at most 64 wrapped map steps, probing cells in a fixed order and following state targets of pass-through blocks |
| [FND-VIEW-008](../../findings/FND-VIEW-008.md) | The candidate helper keeps at most 31 contacts, and a switch table gives each block kind its shape |
| [FND-VIEW-009](../../findings/FND-VIEW-009.md) | For a kind-4 block the raycaster uses the block centre's forward distance as depth and chooses a sprite angle from its heading |
| [FND-VIEW-010](../../findings/FND-VIEW-010.md) | The pixel test reads a block texture by its width, width shift and height, and treats palette index 0 as transparent |
| [FND-VIEW-011](../../findings/FND-VIEW-011.md) | Distance shading picks one of the scene's colour maps from the depth, less a per-block offset |
| [FND-VIEW-012](../../findings/FND-VIEW-012.md) | Every Viewer resource is 108 bytes and starts with x, y, elevation and heading |
| [FND-VIEW-013](../../findings/FND-VIEW-013.md) | The Scenario resource is 568 bytes; its dwords at 20, 24 and 28 count textures, blocks and effects, and 40 to 52 set up the colour maps |
| [FND-VIEW-014](../../findings/FND-VIEW-014.md) | The Backdrop resource is 24 bytes giving a 1,088 by 200 panorama with horizon 199 and heading scale 3, and BackImage holds its pixels row by row |
| [FND-VIEW-015](../../findings/FND-VIEW-015.md) | The backdrop blitter copies BackImage rows from column heading * scale, wrapping, and aligns the backdrop horizon with the view horizon |
| [FND-VIEW-016](../../findings/FND-VIEW-016.md) | Each scene archive has 128 colour maps Pal0 to Pal127 of 256 bytes, in four families of 32 that fade from identity |
| [FND-VIEW-017](../../findings/FND-VIEW-017.md) | The colour map generator blends every palette colour towards one entry by i / count and picks the nearest palette colour by RGB distance |
| [FND-VIEW-018](../../findings/FND-VIEW-018.md) | Scene textures are headerless TEX resources named with their index, width and height, one byte per pixel |
| [FND-VIEW-019](../../findings/FND-VIEW-019.md) | The world renderer computes a kind-4 block's texture column and angle the same way as the raycaster |
| [FND-VIEW-020](../../findings/FND-VIEW-020.md) | The combat maps hold an unreachable gallery of door and passage blocks apart from the area around the Viewer |
| [FND-VIEW-021](../../findings/FND-VIEW-021.md) | Actor sprite blocks point to texture runs of 15, 9, 3 and 8 images with 8, 4, 4 and 2 angles |
